主要内容: The document titled 'g371316k.htm' is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, a Canadian financial institution, with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The filing is dated March 8, 2013, and is related to the issuance of two types of senior global medium-term notes: $1 billion in 0.850% Senior Notes due March 8, 2016, and $1 billion in Senior Floating Rate Notes due March 8, 2016. The filing includes legal opinions from Sullivan & Cromwell LLP and Norton Rose Canada LLP regarding the validity of the notes under U.S. and Canadian law, as well as U.S. federal income taxation matters. The document is part of the Bank’s shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806). The filing is intended to be incorporated by reference into the Bank’s registration statement, and it includes consents from the law firms involved. The report is signed by James Salem, an Executive Vice-President of the Bank.
